sources.title: Alchemist Coder README
sources.locator: What it does, The engine, Editions, Requirements, Repository layout
sources.finding: Desktop app for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build through ACP: Autopilot, agent-driven browser, store tools, unified history search, organization of agents with a coordinator, automations, Board, agent tree with tokens and estimated cost, plan gauges, git tab, Arena of agents in worktrees, extensions hub, local models; Community AGPL edition lacks own-account Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Kimi, which need Pro; no telemetry, no account.

sources.title: core extensions.ts edition gates
sources.finding: Editions community and pro; Pro providers only register in a Pro build; feature gates allow community features or any in Pro.

sources.title: core endpoints.ts
sources.finding: The Community edition only talks to models on this machine or the local network; the check is in open code to define the edition boundary.

sources.title: runner.ts edition check
sources.finding: In Community, a run whose provider is not a local endpoint and not exempt fails with "The Community edition only runs agents on local models"; permission modes default, acceptEdits, plan, bypassPermissions.

sources.title: arena worktrees.ts
sources.finding: Arena creates a new branch and worktree under .alchemist/worktrees for each agent of a task.

sources.title: arena git.ts
sources.finding: Merges and commits run with agent-planted hooks and fsmonitor disabled.

sources.title: main tasks.ts imports
sources.finding: Tasks use worktree creation, planning and execution prompts, runTests, commitAll and mergeBranch.

sources.title: main board.ts
sources.finding: The Board keeps tasks and where each conversation sits in one file of the app's data.

sources.title: main automations.ts
sources.finding: Automations are diagrams that run at a time or repeatedly, with the organization's agents doing each step; what cannot be undone waits for the user.

sources.title: main telegram.ts
sources.finding: Reaches the user on their phone through their own Telegram bot by long polling, with notices and questions with buttons.

sources.title: main git-overview.ts
sources.finding: Git tab pushes the branch, setting upstream to origin when missing.

sources.title: main slash-commands.ts
sources.finding: Built-in actions include fetching the comments on the pull request.

sources.title: en.ts privacy settings strings
sources.finding: Conversations, keys and settings stay on the computer; the app goes online only to run agents against providers, search Open VSX or load previews; Pro verifies a signed licence locally.

sources.title: Alchemist Coder website
sources.finding: Free Community for Mac, Windows and Linux (not signed by Apple); Pro beta $12/month billed monthly, cancel anytime, Mac Apple silicon, adds Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Kimi K3 on your account and cloud agents in the Arena and organization; provider usage paid separately; Stripe checkout.

sources.title: Alchemist Coder issues and discussions
sources.finding: Public issues and discussions for ideas and questions; no dated roadmap.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry, containers, SSO, PR creation
sources.locator: grep -rliE in apps packages (*.ts, *.tsx, excluding tests): "telemetry|analytics|sentry|posthog" (2: browser tabs, locale text), "docker|container" (4: highlighting, find bar, autopilot rules, editor), "saml|sso" (0), "gh pr|pull request" (7: slash commands and locale strings), "webhook" (1: Telegram comment saying no webhook)
sources.finding: No telemetry client, container runtime, SSO or pull-request creation in the Community source; PR support is an agent action that fetches PR comments.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-board
sources.locator: cleanBoard/mergeBoard; renderer components/Board.tsx; automations.ts office queue
sources.finding: Local board stores stable IDs, title/notes, phase, agent/team/automation links and up to10 after dependencies. Window/app updates merge by timestamps. UI edits/searches/project-filters/reopens cards, without arbitrary labels, priority field or discussion ledger. Office queue waits for predecessors still queued/running, releases after completion even if failure, and breaks cycles by starting one; not strict success-based dependency enforcement.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-bots
sources.finding: Product-owned coordinator uses per-run token-authenticated loopback MCP; roles enforce subtree visibility and coordinator-only plan/finish. Up to10 bots/team and depth2. Plans have revisions/feedback/status; plan approval gates child creation when enabled. Agents exchange messages/results, store attributed lessons (max30, editable/removable, relevance selection). Restarts mark live bots stopped, conversations can continue. Agent worktrees may fall back to shared folder. Apply copies patches into current folder, without a reviewed commit digest.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-runtime
sources.locator: runNow/execute/office/constructor; automation-host.ts; tasks.ts enforceBudget; runner.ts start/interrupt
sources.finding: Automations reject overlapping runs, retain failed/stopped status, limit60 steps and6 visits, check daily reported-cost cap between steps and run at most3 office workers. Arena/team budgets stop agents on reported cost; unknown costs cannot enforce a true bill cap. Arena max4; tests10min, git60sec, one-shot design4min. Restart stops live runs, not reattaches. Closing Mac window can leave app running; machine must stay awake.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-arena
sources.finding: Arena persists plan/test command/contestants, worktree diffs, summaries, cost, test output and merge hash. Optional node_modules symlink reuses ignored dependencies. Merge requires ended agent, original branch and clean destination; conflicts abort/reset and report paths. Tests are reported, not required to pass; current contestant work is committed at merge without binding reviewed HEAD. Tests kill process tree after10min and retain last8000 output chars.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-permissions
sources.finding: ACP pending approvals live in memory until answered/stopped; engine blocks known write kinds in plan mode, provider choices carry once/always scope. Runner default is acceptEdits. Autopilot can allow once, but refuses recognized irreversible commands. SecretStore encrypts with OS safeStorage and refuses storage without encryption. Store tools use pinned app-console-mcp0.3.0 only when configured; their confirm flag is not authenticated human approval.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-data
sources.finding: Conversation exports include session/agent metadata, usage, tools/results; HTML defaults omit thinking, JSON serializes full export input. History backup adds/updates and never deletes copied transcripts. History FTS is not code search. Codex handover starts fresh with at most60000 characters of user/assistant text, no tool logs, attachments or private thoughts.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-providers
sources.finding: Built-in Community local providers support Claude Code and Codex, not Gemini/Grok execution. All four histories can be indexed; Gemini/Grok harness adapters are separate from provider availability. Edition guard requires local/LAN endpoint except explicitly exempt providers; providers marked Pro are ignored in Community.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-account
sources.finding: Public Pro1.3.9 Apple-Silicon DMG and SHA256SUMS return200. $12 USD monthly charged at signup, up to3 computers, renews until canceled and retains paid period. No encrypted sync or automatic updates in beta. Intel/Windows/Linux Pro unavailable. No purchase or sign-in performed.

sources.title: Alchemist recovery-privacy
sources.finding: Pro uses Firebase email/subscription/device IDs and Stripe; signed license local, no code/conversations uploaded for billing and no cross-machine sync. Waitlist scope has separate retention. Source README encrypted-sync claim conflicts with current account/privacy pages.

sources.title: Pinned app-console-mcp v0.3.0
sources.finding: Configured store tools expose Play/App Store publication and rollout operations. Mutating functions default confirm=false; confirm=true executes using configured service credentials, without an independently authenticated approval or artifact digest. Product integrates this exact public tag through uv.

sources.title: Alchemist Coder Community pinned telemetry source inspection
sources.locator: README.md line 82 (No telemetry, no account); bounded search of apps/desktop and packages/ for telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Segment, Sentry, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Bugsnag, Datadog, gtag, crashReporter and crash reporting, excluding lockfiles, node_modules, tests, fixtures and Sentry MCP tool definitions
sources.finding: The Community README says the app sends nothing about the user or their code; on its own it only asks npm and PyPI for current agent CLI versions. The source search found no analytics, crash-reporting or usage-upload client in the Community desktop app or its packages. The closed Pro build is not in this repository.
